consumer: The frontend's 'is the player currently holding a 1st_aid?' check, equivalent to an engine possession predicate (e.g. Character::has_amount/has_item_with) asking whether the avatar possesses that item.
scope: The avatar's full possession reach: every item the engine would count as held, recursing into nested container contents and charge-aware, not just top-level wielded/worn/inventory stacks.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items — enumerates only top-level wielded_items(), worn, and inv_const_slice() stacks, emitting them as a flat list with no recursion into container contents and no possession predicate.
divergence: A 1st_aid kit stored inside a backpack (or any container) in the avatar's inventory: the engine's possession check reports held=true, but write_carried_items only lists the top-level backpack stack and never emits the nested 1st_aid, so the frontend re-deriving from the list answers held=false.
